notes: Copy outside the repo and fill only after testing the exact commit as the build shape that ships (release configuration, exact NMH_DEVELOPER_ID_APPLICATION identity, hardened runtime) following docs/ai-acceptance-testing.md. Validators require status=approved, exact commit/version/bundle match, exact tested_build.build_id for that commit (stale builds fail), exact intended signing identity with UAT and manifest on the same team, all ten checks passed with no unknown checks (pending/failed fail closed), and real approved_by/approved_at_utc/machine values. approved_by names the truthful test executor: an AI agent/session identifier (for example 'ai-acceptance <agent> <session>') or the responsible operator; never impersonate a human. Set every check to passed only with durable observation/artifact evidence; automated assertions without observed runtime and artifact evidence do not satisfy acceptance.
